messages:
lee_rust: quick heads-up: ran the new rust sampleapp with prefetch=8 + concurrency=24 and saw a thundering herd after forcing token rotate. lots of 429s and then a long cooldown. anyone else hit this?
nora_tests: saw similar in a CI stress run last week but chalked it up to our test harness. do you have logs?
lee_rust: log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-24T09:05:10Z [req=33] status=401 token_expired
2026-03-24T09:05:10Z token refresh start
2026-03-24T09:05:15Z token refresh done
2026-03-24T09:05:15Z many immediate retries -> 429 x 120
```
The rust client currently grabs an async mutex for the whole client during refresh; all request tasks await the lock and then retrigger immediately.
sam_sdk: that's the classic head-of-line problem. our go/js sdks use a single-winner refresh future (compare-and-swap) so other requests await the future without serializing retries. rust mutex here is too coarse.
pat_onboard: the sampleapp prefetcher is also aggressive: it spawns fetch workers as soon as a slot frees. combined with the lock this amplifies spikes.
lee_rust: suggested fixes I sketched: (1) narrow lock: only perform the actual HTTP refresh under lock; do cheap expiry check outside, (2) convert refresh gate to a shared future so awaiters don't re-run refresh path, (3) add per-request backoff state that survives a refresh and (4) change sampleapp defaults to prefetch=2 + staggered jitter (30-150ms).
infra_gary: +1 to a runtime patch. this affects hosted customers if many small clients perform token rotation simultaneously. can we also respect Retry-After header and apply a min backoff window?
sam_sdk: will implement: shared refresh future (once_cell+parking_lot?), stable per-request backoff that doesn't reset on refresh, honor Retry-After if present, and add optional prefetch semaphore for sample apps. i'll open an RFC + PR.
nora_tests: i'll add CI stress tests that simulate token expiry across N clients and assert no synchronized retry spike (assert 95th pct spike less than 2x baseline).
ci-bot: CI: created ticket RN-9724 and branch rust-prefetch-fix, draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/rust-sdk/pull/4870. tests queued.
pat_onboard: can we get a short blurb in onboarding docs: "prefetch: safe defaults"? new users run sampleapps a lot and we should avoid giving them an anti-pattern.
lee_rust: agreed. also propose a diagnostic flag in sampleapp to simulate token expiry so folks can see safe prefetch settings locally.
infra_gary: after PR merge i'll run a small canary in staging with 100 parallel sampleapps to validate no herd.
sam_sdk: PR will include migration notes for rust users and a compatibility flag to revert to old behavior for a release cycle.
pat_onboard: i'll update the quickstart and add a note in the "common gotchas" section.
lee_rust: thanks everyone. once merged i'll pick up follow-ups for go/python parity checks.
